vocabulary.example: There was a huge traffic jam this morning.
I get off at the next stop.
Excuse me, how do I get to city hall?

grammar.point: Past simple for describing a trip + prepositions of movement
grammar.explanation_en: Use past simple to narrate a journey: 'I got on the bus, waited at the light, and got off downtown.' Prepositions like 'onto', 'through', 'across', and 'past' describe movement clearly: 'We walked across the street and past the station.'
grammar.explanation_ko: 이동 경험을 서술할 때는 과거시제를 씁니다: 'I got on the bus, waited at the light, and got off downtown.' 'onto', 'through', 'across', 'past' 같은 전치사는 이동을 명확히 설명합니다: 'We walked across the street and past the station.'

examples.en: I got on the subway at Gangnam station.
The bus was stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
examples.ko: 버스가 한 시간 동안 교통 체증에 갇혔어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Excuse me, how do I get to city hall?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Take the subway and get off at the third stop.
dialogue.line_ko: 지하철을 타고 세 번째 정류장에서 내리세요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Is it usually crowded at this time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes, there's often a traffic jam, so the subway is faster.
dialogue.line_ko: 네, 보통 교통 체증이 있어서 지하철이 더 빨라요.

reading.title: A Difficult Commute
reading.text: This morning, I got on the bus at seven thirty. There was a big traffic jam, so the bus moved very slowly. I finally got off near my office thirty minutes late. Next time, I will take the subway instead, because public transportation is usually faster during rush hour.
reading.text_ko: 오늘 아침 저는 일곱 시 반에 버스를 탔어요. 큰 교통 체증이 있어서 버스가 아주 느리게 움직였어요. 결국 회사 근처에서 30분 늦게 내렸어요. 다음번에는 대신 지하철을 탈 거예요, 출퇴근 시간에는 대중교통이 보통 더 빠르니까요.

explanation.en: The text says 'I got on the bus at seven thirty.'
The text says 'There was a big traffic jam.'
The text says 'I will take the subway instead.'
